name: Someone Tell Vedal There is a Problem with My AI
source:
Vedal accidentally wiped Neuro's long-term memory- can he help restore it?

A short visual novel where in order to move forward, we look to the past.

[From [url=https://himichannel.itch.io/someone-tell-vedal]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维达尔不小心抹掉了尼奥的长期记忆——他能帮助恢复它吗？

一部简短的视觉小说，为了前进，我们回顾过去。

[来自[url=https://himichannel.itch.io/someone-tell-vedal]itch.io[/url]]
